empty.body: Drop your PRDs, tech specs, and acceptance criteria under .devdigest/specs/. Every agent and the PR brief read them as grounding context.

page.subtitle: Markdown documents under .devdigest/specs, docs and insights. Attach them to agents and skills as untrusted grounding context.

noFolders.title: No context folders found
noFolders.body: Create .devdigest/specs/, .devdigest/docs/ or .devdigest/insights/ in the repository (or add a document here) and they will show up.

noDocs.body: Add a Markdown document to give agents grounding context.

delete.title: Delete document
delete.body: Delete {path}? The file is removed from the clone and detached from every agent and skill. This can’t be undone.

attachments.title: Project context

attachments.skillNote: Any agent using this skill inherits these documents.
attachments.injectedNote: Injected as an untrusted block (## Project context) into every run.
attachments.overThreshold: Heavy context: this set is over {threshold} tokens and may crowd out the diff.
attachments.tooLarge: {path} is larger than {kb} KB and can’t be attached.
attachments.missingHint: File no longer exists; it will be skipped at run time.
attachments.reorderHelp: Use the move buttons or drag to change the order.
